summary: Manage access for any application, find admins faster, and give your security team a full review pack.

new.title: Custom workloads, for example SAP
new.text: Templates > Custom workloads lets you define an application PIM Manager has no connector for, with its roles. PIM Manager then maintains one Entra group per delegated role.

new.title: Filter admin accounts
new.text: Admin accounts now has filter chips for type, privilege, platform, department and status, and each admin shows a High-priv or Day-to-day badge.

new.title: Environment report
new.text: Operations > Environment report shows your PIM Manager setup live: identities and their permissions, Azure resources, network exposure and findings with the fix. Export it as PDF.

new.title: Clear choices for extras in Drift
new.text: An item in the tenant but not in PIM Manager now offers Import into PIM, Delete or Ignore. Deleting a whole group is its own separate commit.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: A security review pack for your CISO, More info on every setting, per-recipient notifications, Settings > Reports, PDF export, Reader access for department owners, and a clearer daily changes mail.

fixes.title: Operational policy settings now take effect
fixes.text: Require MFA on activation and the maximum activation and eligibility durations are now applied on top of every policy template. They never loosen a template.
fixes.action: If your own policy template should stay without MFA, switch "Require MFA on activation" off before the next engine run.

fixes.title: New groups are not role-assignable by default
fixes.text: Following Microsoft's guidance, a new group is role-assignable only when it needs to be. Existing groups are not changed.

fixes.title: Managed tenants keep their own groups
fixes.text: A managed tenant's own groups and access are never overwritten or removed by the managing tenant, even when names match.

fixes.title: Update ring moves no longer block updates
fixes.text: An environment ahead of its ring is no longer reported as a failed update, and moving an environment between rings no longer blocks its updates.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Get Started > Mail sender turns green once mail works, duplicate group tags and blank naming patterns are refused, and switched-off pages stay off.
